task.description:
Design integration tests for TNT-05, TNT-06, and TNT-07.

TNT-05 tests:
- Run backfill for a tenant with N rows in public business tables; verify all N rows now in tenant schema; verify 0 remain in public for that tenant
- Interrupt backfill mid-run; re-run; verify no duplicate rows (idempotency via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING)
- Run backfill for a zero-row tenant; verify completes with no-ops
- Run backfill for a row with unknown tenant_id; verify row written to public.tnt05_orphans
- Verify migration-window flag set at start and cleared at completion
- Verify per-tenant progress in public.tnt05_progress

TNT-06 tests:
- Verify tenant_schemas has db_host column after migration
- With db_host = NULL, pool uses default BPM_DB_URL
- Export produces a self-contained dump (pg_dump output contains tenant schema DDL)
- After UPDATE tenant_schemas SET db_host = S2, pool routes subsequent requests to S2
- Setting tenant.status = 'MIGRATING' causes write requests to return 503; read requests succeed

TNT-07 tests:
- Pre-flight check with one tenant not in tnt05_progress COMPLETED: verify migration aborts, lists unready tenant, no DDL changes
- Pre-flight check with all tenants COMPLETED: migration proceeds
- After migration: SHOW RLS on each business table returns OFF
- After migration: public.bpm_effective_tenant_id() does not exist
- After migration: SELECT count(*) FROM public.events returns 0 (no business data in public)
- zig build test passes after migration (no test relies on RLS in public)
- Migration is idempotent: running twice produces no error

All tests: per-test UUIDs, cleanup via defer, fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL absent.
Write specs to tests/specs/TNT-05.md, TNT-06.md, TNT-07.md.
Write test source to tests/integration/tnt_backfill_export_cleanup_test.zig.
Set next_action: 'Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 3b)'
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/TNT-05.md exists with backfill idempotency, orphan, progress tracking, and window-flag tests
tests/specs/TNT-06.md exists with db_host routing, export, import, and MIGRATING status tests
tests/specs/TNT-07.md exists with pre-flight abort and full DDL cleanup tests
Integration test source files exist in tests/integration/
Tests clean up after themselves via defer
Tests fail clearly if BPM_TEST_DB_URL absent
No error.SkipZigTest on MUST requirement tests
